VOL-II:9.4 already says 'Construction water shall not be abstracted from the local aquifer.' The added words 'whether or not it is treated before use' clarify rather than change; a person confirms.

The response 'Bidders are referred to Section 3 of this Addendum' and the date 'not later than Sunday 22 November 2026' equal four Working Days before the Proposal Due Date of 26 November 2026 (ADD-03 3.2), so it repeats rather than alters. The obligation itself is carried by 3.2 (another batch); a person confirms.
